selection_note: Sixth full nonoverlapping cohort from canonical included S1=A Index source assessments, four reviewed 2026-10-22 plus one canonical reviewed 2026-10-21. Prioritises tested first-party Go/Rust CLI code paths: task-scope advisory, child tool registry, permission gating, writer patch transaction, session recovery. Fixed native scripts/code tests only; no provider or LLM agent runs. All first 25 candidate sources remain excluded; source identity and order frozen.

candidates.finding: Chord's optional first-party delegated coding task registry records overlapping write scopes and produces conflict hints; use pinned Go task registry tests to screen deterministic scope comparisons and recovery, without running a model.

The Rust coding CLI's built-in swarm path constructs child agents with a tool registry; test fixed-input registry capability and error behavior using native cargo checks, without invoking model-guided child agents.

Gopi wires permission enforcement, file edits and read-only child delegation into the shipped Go tool registry; screen deterministic denied-write and invalid-path behavior with native Go tests, not LLM sessions.

Iteron's host-mediated writer transactions seal patch hashes and verify worktree/head constraints before applying changes; use pinned native Rust tests for conflict and refusal boundaries without invoking providers.

Bough ships Go session/history persistence and task execution management in the first-party CLI; screen native fixed-input history/session restoration and conflict behavior without starting a model-guided coding loop.
